result.summary: REQ-047 (Letflow.Engine.TaskActivation, wired into persist/7's Ecto.Multi via append_multi/6) reviewed against the four idiom-review questions. (1) No gen_statem/GenServer crutch -- this is pure Ecto.Multi.run/3 composition inside the caller's already-open transaction; TaskActivation.append_multi/6 makes zero Repo calls of its own (INV-EE47-7), matching the EventStore.append/2 / SnapshotStore.create/3 pattern already established. (2) Supervision untouched -- git diff main...HEAD touches zero files under lib/letflow/process_instance.ex, lib/letflow/instance_supervisor.ex, or lib/letflow/application.ex; per-instance isolation via Letflow.InstanceSupervisor is unaffected. (3) No new type-safety gap found: assignee_type/assignee_ref resolution (resolve_assignee/1) reads directly off Graph.Node.attributes with no invented defaults, and Task.status is excluded from insert_changeset/2's cast list so every row is PENDING by construction -- nothing here needs a docs/issues/ type-safety filing. (4) No scope creep: cancel_pending_timers/2 is a documented named no-op hook explicitly deferred to S6 (matches stage-3-instance-engine.md's stated pattern of a named hook over a partial implementation), and TaskActivation builds no node-type re-validation or group-membership logic ahead of what REQ-047's own design calls for. Verified against docs/migration/decisions/0006: lib/letflow/engine/task.ex's own moduledoc documents 'No tenant_id column (Decision 0006 D2)', and neither task_activation.ex nor the engine.ex diff introduces a tenant_id field anywhere (grep confirms the only tenant_id references in the diff are engine.ex's pre-existing reject_tenant_id/1 validation, unrelated to this table). Checked docs/anti-patterns.md's ISS-0051 fix in test/letflow/engine_test.exs: confirmed genuinely mechanical -- only the describe/test name strings were shortened (same class as ISS-0030/0033/0040/0049, this project's known 255-char ExUnit SystemLimitError ceiling); the two `assert doc =~ ...` assertion bodies inside the test are byte-for-byte unchanged, and ISS-0051.yaml documents it as pre-existing (reproduces via git stash on pre-REQ-047 tree) and blocking under Unblock-Everything, not new REQ-047 scope. No blocking findings.
